fixes.was: A clerk discharged without sufficient cause during a pay period who remains willing to serve the rest of it is treated in law as having served the whole period and may recover the unpaid salary as a debt for work and labour.
fixes.now: A clerk discharged without sufficient cause during a quarter who remains willing to serve the rest of it is treated in law as having served the whole quarter and may recover the unpaid salary as a debt for work and labour.

fixes.was: A seller is liable for the buyer's losses on resale contracts only if circumstances known to the seller at contracting made it reasonably foreseeable that its breach would cause the buyer to breach them; mere knowledge of intended resale is not enough where substitutes are available.
fixes.now: A seller is liable for the buyer's losses on resale contracts only if circumstances known to the seller at contracting made it reasonably foreseeable that its breach would cause the buyer to breach them; mere knowledge that the buyer is a wholesaler or intends resale is not enough.
